en: Colorized historic postcard showing a grand Neo-Renaissance spa or palace-like building with two domed corner towers and a richly decorated central façade, set in a landscaped park with trees and walking paths. Two elegantly dressed figures stroll in the foreground. A broad road runs along the right side, with wooded hills rising behind the complex. Stylized red captions appear at the bottom, along with printer information.
